summary: Typed expiring phone commands use foreground collections and reactive result waits

replay.detail: Commands and bounded terminal outcomes exist only in issuing-member memory; never claims, replication, persistence, or replay.

schema.detail: Adds DeviceCommandRequest, DeviceCommand, DeviceResult and the commands resource collection to client-v0. No database or claim schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, replication, or durable retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds phone-commands version 1 and deviceCommand, deviceCommandGet(wait), deviceResult operations. New clients must probe the granted capability before subscribing to commands or using command routes. Existing snapshot/changes frames are reused; old daemons reject an unknown collection with their existing error frame. Existing clients never subscribe and need no new frame decoder.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption. Restart discards ephemeral commands and outcomes.

manual.detail: No upgrade action. Phone execution requires phone handlers; the contract and daemon boundary do not add push or background execution.

recovery.detail: Evicted or restart-lost commands are unavailable, not replayed. Only explicitly issue a fresh command if desired; never automatically replay an expired command.
